revision: D1 assembly proposal, not manufacturing release

battery_allocation.status: Allocated space only, NOT dimensions of the PiSugar supplied cell; no battery compression or final tray approved

module_thickness_status: PCB thickness, standoffs, connectors and PiSugar components remain prototype allowances until exact revision and kit geometry are measured

joystick_allocation.status: RKJXV122400R selected prototype candidate, nominal body dimensions from Alps Alpine. Simplified solid, NOT exact COM-09032 replacement guarantee. Printed mounting/cap and full 23 degree motion require qualification.

base_board_d1.status: Proposed wider carrier; mounting posts moved outside battery allocation. Supersedes D0 base only in D1 sources.

motor_status: VG0832013D nominal body; bracket and adhesive need mechanical/haptic qualification. Arc adjusted to clear the allocated battery in this proposal.
shoulder_status: Printed lever/pivot with cover clearances and 3 mm shaft proposal; L1/R1 tactile and L2/R2 potentiometer attachment, return springs and hard stops remain unqualified.
notes: This D1 vertical allocation supersedes D0 envelope Z only in the new assembly; D0 source and consultation snapshots are preserved.
72 mm total height is a design proposal requiring ergonomics review, not a user-approved requirement.
The lower PCB supports the removable PiSugar/Pi stack mechanically; GPIO uses a polarized ribbon cable, not an assumed underside socket.
Routing status and physical collisions are separate: an electrically connected PCB does not establish mechanical fit.
